profile.ja: 古今東西の武具や忍具を集める武器マニアであり、様々な武器で全身武装して戦う学生対魔忍。つい最近まで忍法が発現せず、おまけに戦闘センスにも恵まれていないせいで卑屈な性格だったが、両親に強制山籠りを命じられた際、野生の獣に襲われたことがきっかけで能力に開眼。九死に一生を得る。彼女に目覚めたのは、武器の記憶を読み取る“器遁の術”。それからは任務をこなしつつ、武器を集めるのを趣味にしている。“器遁の術”は武器や道具の記憶を読み取り、かつての持ち主の技術を一時的に習得する能力。これにより、使ったことのない武器でも手にした瞬間に達人のごとき立ち回りを可能とする。ただし使い手自身の特殊な能力や術は再現できず、身体能力を大きく超えた動きも真似出来ない。能力に目覚めてからも、卑屈でオドオドした性格は治らない……のだが根は意外と図々しく、無理なお願いもとりあえず口に出してみるタイプ。陰キャではあるがメンタルは意外と強く、辛い修行や理不尽な任務に泣き言を言いつつも、なんやかんやで最後までやり遂げる底力を持ち合わせている。普段はテンションが低いのに、趣味である武器や忍具の話をする時だけ生き生きとするので、そのギャップで周囲からも変わった子だと可愛がられている。
profile.en: She is a student Taimanin and a weapon maniac who collects arms and ninja tools from all over the world, fighting with a variety of weapons. Until recently, she had not developed her ninja abilities and was not blessed with combat sense, which made her have a humble personality. However, when she was forced by her parents to undergo intense training in the mountains and was attacked by a wild beast, she discovered her ability to read the memories of weapons, known as "Kiton no Jutsu". Since then, she has been completing her missions while collecting weapons as a hobby. Her "Kiton no Jutsu" allows her to read the memories of weapons and tools, temporarily acquiring the skills of their former owners. This enables her to wield even unfamiliar weapons with expertise, but she cannot replicate the user's special abilities or techniques, nor can she mimic movements that exceed her physical capabilities. Even after discovering her abilities, her humble and timid personality remains, but she is unexpectedly bold and will make unreasonable requests. Despite being an introvert, she has a strong mental toughness, and while she may complain about difficult training or unreasonable missions, she has the determination to see them through to the end. Normally, she has a low tension, but when talking about her hobby of weapons and ninja tools, she becomes lively, and this gap in her personality makes her loved by those around her.
